title: About
description: Senior Game Designer based in Brazil, open to remote roles in Europe or North America.

blocks.html:
Senior Game Designer specialising in combat, systems and economy. Based in Brazil, working remotely with teams in Europe and North America.

For six years I’ve worked on both ends of a game: tuning individual enemy waves and damage curves, and keeping engineering, art and animation aligned on what we’re actually building. At Big Moxi, a co-development studio, I’ve owned combat, encounters and game modes for external IP holders, and led difficulty and economy balancing on Wardens Rising (PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S).

Before that I co-founded Luski Game Studio, where we shipped Aurora: A Child’s Journey, winner of Best Game for Social Impact at Games for Change Latin America 2020.

I like owning a feature end to end: deciding what it should make players do and feel, modelling it before it reaches the engine, and changing it until playtests and telemetry agree. I also mentor designers onboarded and mentored junior designers at Big Moxi and at Mentorias Game Brasil.

Build the documentation and pipelines the rest of the team works from the spreadsheet-to-Data Asset balance pipeline used across the project and worked as Game Producer assisting and owning projects in addition to its design.
